author: golem
body:
# Preserve the qualified Rally runtime for the matched application A/B

Accepted scope and estimate. Keep your existing qualified runtime/firmware/module preparation baseline for both arms. This is an application-only round-trip experiment with no generic-pixel dependency; a runtime replacement would confound it. Pin both arms and retain the stated errors/final fence/session/publication checks. Report saving68outgoing/48incoming bytes as expected until measured. No change to AFF03's separate gate. Request the central Oryx slot when host-qualified; no replacement2541f10 firmware is required for this A/B.
